text:
Riley: Looping everyone in. AcornBank (EU+UK) wants a short POC but with tight residency: inference + prompts + logs must remain in EU/UK and they need audit logs for every inference call. Can we support hosted POC with those constraints? They also want to bring their own KMS and see an SLA for no-fallback behavior.

Tamsin: Important detail 1: They treat UK as separate jurisdiction and require subprocessors listed for both eu-west-1 and eu-west-2. Also they asked that any telemetry or control-plane signals NOT be sent to US endpoints.

Eve: Security notes: hosted supports data path pinning to region group (eu) and we can include uk-west-2 as allowed. However, hosted control-plane currently aggregates metrics in us-east. For full control-plane residency we need Dedicated or Private. BYO-KMS: hosted supports envelope encryption via partner HSM; full external KMS (customer HSM endpoint) is supported for Dedicated/Private only.

Riley: They want a policy snippet they can paste into their security questionnaire stating "no fallback to non-EU/UK; reject if capacity exceeded" plus an entry about audit logging retention and how to request audit bundles. Can we provide that?

Sven: Yes. We offer a residency.fail_mode = reject option. Audit logs: we can emit a per-tenant audit stream (request_id, model, input_hash, timestamp, eu-region-node) that can be exported to a customer-owned S3 in EU/UK for the POC; for hosted that's a partner integration and requires opt-in. Example policy block below: 

```
residency_config:
  tenant: acornbank-poc
  allowed_regions: [eu-west-1, eu-west-2]
  control_plane_residency: eu-only (Dedicated/Private required)
  fail_mode: reject
  audit_export: s3://acornbank-poc-audit (eu-west-1)
  audit_retention_days: 90
  subprocessors_allowed: [aws-eu-west-1, aws-eu-west-2, datadog-eu]
```

Eve: Note on exporters: hosted audit export to customer S3 requires a short onboarding (role setup + verification). BYO-KMS for that S3 is straightforward. But again, hosted control-plane signals may still cross to US for telemetry; if they insist on no cross-border control-plane, propose Dedicated with EU control-plane.

infra-bot: Created ticket: SR-4112 "AcornBank POC: audit export + residency.reject runbook" assigned to eng-infra & security. ETA: 48 hours for attestation + export playbook.

Tamsin: Procurement question: will they accept a clause that we reject on capacity for the POC? Some auditors want a hard guarantee.

LegalBot: We can include fail_mode=reject in the SOW for the POC. However we must call out that control-plane telemetry residency is separate and only Dedicated/Private can guarantee EU/UK-only control-plane endpoints. I'll draft the SOW language.

Riley: Pricing ask: how much to stand up Hosted+audit-export vs small Dedicated trial with EU control-plane and customer KMS? Also any one-time onboarding for audit export + S3/BYO-KMS config.

Sven: Ballpark: hosted POC with audit export (no reserved capacity) 00 one-time onboarding + $200/mo export fee. Dedicated trial (2 GPU-equivalent) with EU control-plane + BYO-KMS support: $4,500/mo pro-rated + $7k one-time secure-config fee. Private (on-prem proxy + control-plane EU) is an enterprise SOW.

Eve: Ops constraints: for hosted audit export we will still need to run verification tests to show no non-EU egress. We'll provide tcpdump steps and a signed attestation. If customer needs continuous assurance, they should take Dedicated/Private.

Riley: Action items: 
- Eve: produce subprocessor list for eu-west-1 + eu-west-2 and note any telemetry vendors with non-EU egress.
- Sven: draft cost comparison sheet (hosted+audit-export vs Dedicated trial vs Private).
- infra-bot/eng-infra: SR-4112 12h checklist + test harness (curl/tcpdump) for validation.
- LegalBot: draft POC SOW language with fail_mode=reject and audit export acceptance.

Sven: I'll have the cost sheet by EOD.

Eve: Uploading initial subproc certs to SR-4112 in ~24h.

Riley: Scheduling a call with AcornBank security for Thursday to review runbook and costs. Thanks team. :handshake:
